نثم (form I)
# نَثُمُّ (naṯummu) /na.θum.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# نُثَمُّ (nuṯammu) /nu.θam.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# نَثُمَّ (naṯumma) /na.θum.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# نُثَمَّ (nuṯamma) /nu.θam.ma/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/juss
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
